extracted_information: This article describes how to make API-based connections to Microsoft Sentinel for ingesting data from various Azure, Microsoft 365 services, Amazon Web Services, and Windows Server services. It outlines common information for API-based data connectors, including prerequisites and connection steps.

permissions: Read and write permissions on the Log Analytics workspace.

pricing.Microsoft 365: Deployment on the same tenant as Microsoft Sentinel workspace; other charges may apply.
pricing.Microsoft Power BI: Office 365 deployment on the same tenant as Microsoft Sentinel workspace; other charges may apply.
pricing.Microsoft Purview Information Protection: Office 365 deployment on the same tenant as Microsoft Sentinel workspace; other charges may apply.
pricing.Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Managemen: Valid subscription for Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5, or accompanying Compliance/IRM add-ons; IRM fully onboarded with defined policies producing alerts; Microsoft 365 IRM configured to export alerts to Office 365 Management Activity API.

features.name: API-based connection process
features.description: General method for connecting Microsoft services to Microsoft Sentinel via API.
steps: From the Microsoft Sentinel navigation menu, select Data connectors.
Select your service from the data connectors gallery, and then select Open Connector Page on the preview pane.
Select Connect to start streaming events and/or alerts from your service into Microsoft Sentinel.
If the connector page has a 'Create incidents - recommended!' section, select Enable to automatically create incidents from alerts.
